guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Create Your Cambria Account
guide.description: Visit the Cambria lobby and set up an account. Use invite code 9df14149 at sign-up, which gives both you and the referrer a points boost on future activity.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Link Your Wallets
guide.description: Connect an EVM wallet, a Solana wallet, and an Abstract wallet from your account settings. Cambria checks activity across all three when it calculates your Degen and Chad Scores, so linking all of them matters even if you only plan to play on one chain.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Check Your Loot Chests Eligibility
guide.description: Once your wallets are linked, head to the claims dashboard to see your Degen Score and Chad Score, along with any Loot Chests you’ve already qualified for. Your Care Package size scales based on your degen score across: Solana trading activity (memecoins, DeFi, prediction markets) Polymarket trading activity Multi-chain risk-taking (perps, options, NFT trading) Time-weighted holdings across degen-
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Claim Your Loot Chests
guide.description: Claim available chests from the lobby within the 14-day claim window. Chests convert into $RSGP allocations, and anything tied to an eligible wallet is also sent automatically at TGE.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Fund Your Wallet for Gameplay
guide.description: Playing Dungeons and Gold Rush takes USDC or ETH for Risk Keys and in-game costs. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Play Dungeons for Loot and Points
guide.description: Buy a Risk Key for about 0.1 USDC and run a dungeon. Extract successfully and you keep the loot; die inside and you lose the key’s stake. Loot you cash out at the Royal Treasury converts into Genesis Airdrop points on top of any in-game currency.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Earn Points Through Duel Arena and Side Activities
guide.description: Duel Arena lets you wager directly against other players in 1v1 fights, and side activities like Pit Fights, island fishing, and bar games generate smaller, steady point drips between bigger runs.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Mint a Royal Charter for Full Seasonal Earning
guide.description: During Gold Rush seasons, minting a Royal Charter unlocks full earning features and daily energy regeneration. Without one, you can still play, but your point accumulation is capped.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
